title: Decision Tables — Overview
summary: Tables mapping combinations of conditions to expected actions for complex business rules.
body:
Tables mapping combinations of conditions to expected actions for complex business rules. Standard technique for rule-heavy logic.

Approaches commonly used alongside it include State Transition, Equivalence Partitioning, Business Rules.
